card.name: Linking words in handling instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, to, of, until, a) right after a container, device or object in preparation and handling instructions. Also seen at a figure number gap and partway through a word like preloaded.

modes.label: Linking word after container
modes.description: A preposition such as for, to or until follows a bag, vial, device or container in handling steps.
